integrity.degree_basis: For an n-dimensional polarized toric variety, projective degree equals n! times lattice-covolume volume.
integrity.euler_basis: The braid fan has (n+1)! maximal cones and the smooth complete toric variety has one torus fixed point for each.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for math/0507163 lists version 1 on 2005-07-07.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival Coxeter-toric source arXiv:0806.0680 lists primary MSC 14M25 and studies the complex toric variety of a Coxeter fan.
integrity.volume_basis: Postnikov records that the regular permutohedron of order n+1 has lattice-covolume volume (n+1)^(n-1), the Cayley tree count.

scientific_limitations: The projective degree is for the standard toric polarization attached to the regular permutohedron, not for arbitrary generalized-permutohedron polarizations.
The comparison uses classical volume and toric fixed-point formulas, so an older or unindexed source may contain the same ratio under different terminology.
No statement is made about dual, Euclidean-distance, or other projective degrees.
title: A tree–permutation crossover for permutohedral toric varieties
